# Abla IA

> Abla answers your restaurant's WhatsApp 24/7, takes the order, confirms it and prints it in your kitchen. It handles 50+ customers at once. From COP 279,000 a month, no commission.

Abla IA is a WhatsApp AI for restaurants in Colombia: it answers customers on WhatsApp 24/7, takes the full order, has the customer confirm it and prints the ticket in the kitchen. It talks with 50+ customers at the same time. Abla also offers a phone AI, an online store with QR ordering, a self-order kiosk and a POS.

## Prices (Colombian pesos)
- WhatsApp AI: COP 279,000 a month, plus a one-time installation of COP 349,000
- Reservations by WhatsApp: COP 34,900 a month on top, or reservations only COP 139,000 a month
- Extra language: COP 34,900 a month per language (Spanish included, 60+ languages available)
- Phone AI, online store, kiosk and POS: quote per restaurant
- No commission per order. Restaurants need a laptop and a ticket printer.
